result: Passed across current Windows 10, prior Windows 11 and Debian WSL2 evidence, plus Android API 35

checks.command: Run debug-only Android Keystore probes using synthetic, non-production values; force-stop and relaunch the app for persistence verification; delete all synthetic entries
checks.details: Synthetic tests verified write/read-match, wrong-value rejection, atomic overwrite, access-versus-refresh key separation, identity isolation, deletion and absence after deletion. A second synthetic entry remained readable after app process restart and was then deleted. No production credential was used or returned to the frontend, and the test entries were removed.
checks.security_boundary: All probes require target_os=android, debug_assertions and the explicit android-debug-validation feature. The release APK native library was inspected with NDK llvm-nm and defines none of debug_credential_put, debug_credential_get_matches, debug_credential_present, debug_credential_delete or debug_credential_key_info.
